Executor completion claim:
<completion_summary>
Shipped v0.34.68: bug 1.7's silent "list/goal disallows until we restart" mode-gate rejection is replaced with a self-heal. Root cause confirmed in code: readState (goal-loop-core.ts) trusts the active.jsonl `state` event verbatim, so a parse failure can leave state.goal.policy outside {goal,list}; every gate branching on `state.goal.policy === "list"` then silently refused the wrong surface until a restart rebuilt clean state. The fix adds two core functions — parseGoalPolicyFromMd (re-parses the durable `**Policy**: …` marker from the active-goal .md in .pi-glla/goals/) and healCorruptedGoalPolicy(state, cwd) (repairs the corrupted in-memory policy in place, ledgering goal_policy_healed, or goal_policy_heal_failed when no durable source exists — never inventing a mode) — plus a goal.ts wrapper healGoalPolicy(ctx) that heals, persists, and notifies "Recovered the goal mode … no restart needed". It runs at the top of cmdGoal and cmdList (before any policy gate) and at session_start immediately after readState — the session-start placement matters because the restore gate would otherwise rewrite the durable .md with the corrupted value before the gate could re-parse it (discovered while debugging: the restore-hold path calls updateGoal → writeGoalMd). Tests: new tests/policy-self-heal.test.ts (7 tests) pins the parse, the heal (corrupted→healed with ledger evidence), the healthy no-op, the no-source heal_failed honesty, the readState round-trip (healed policy persists — no restart needed), and the two bug-1.7 gate regressions: `/list pause` and `/goal pause` with a corrupted in-memory policy plus a truthful durable .md heal at the gate and proceed with the policy-correct guidance instead of refusing. Gates: 965 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail across 87 files, tsc clean, committed (daemon af33f8b4 = core+goal.ts+test file; 972c929 = CHANGELOG), git diff HEAD -- extensions/ tests/ empty.
